posts.title: The October #DrupalOffTheIsland challenge
posts.description: During the Driesnote at DrupalCon Rotterdam, one of the closing points was that Drupal has evolved light years beyond its reputation. And that's true. But it's also true that there is a whole world of people out there who've never heard of Drupal, and we need to talk about it differently to them than we do when talking amongst the Drupal-aware. Enter The October "Off the Drupal Island" challenge .

posts.title: Introducing the Drupal AI Learners Club!
posts.description: Coming out of DrupalCon Chicago , there was both fear and excitement around AI, a tension captured well in the Driesnote . One of the best ways to confront fear is through learning, and one of the best ways to learn is with friends! :D Come join the Drupal AI Learners Club (#ai-learners on Drupal Slack ) where we share tips and tricks and answer questions about how to use Drupal and AI together.
